Do NOT use when the target is something other than a redis/rabbitmq broker (a hypervisor, storage appliance, backup product, container-orchestration cluster, database server, monitoring stack, or OT/industrial equipment) — route those to the appropriate other AIops-tools skill. Managed cloud queue services and other broker products are out of scope. Governed broker operations with a built-in governance harness (audit, policy, token budget, undo, risk-tiers). skills.description_zh: CTF Web 方向出题大师。当用户需要设计、规划并制作一道 CTF Web 安全题目（含漏洞设计、攻击拓扑、flag 埋设、题面与 writeup）时使用本技能。它以「需求采集 → 攻击拓扑与预期解设计 → 方案规划 → 二次确认 → 内容制作与题解 → 成果审阅 → 第三方解题自检」七阶段推进，且每个阶段完成后都会等待用户反馈确认后再进入下一阶段。收尾的第三方解题自检会用独立 agent 仅凭玩家材料实解出题，验证题目可解且无硬编码常量。触发词：出 CTF 题、Web 方向出题、设计安全题目、CTF web challenge、帮我出一道 web 题。
skills.name: CTF Web 方向出题大师
